say:1:1130636001:1.text: Some folks came back walking, others lying down, and some were just flat-out never seen again.
say:1:1130636001:1.source_cn: 有些走着回来了，有些躺着回来了，还有些走了就没见过。
say:1:1130636001:1.male: Some folks came back walking, others lying down, and some were just flat-out never seen again.
say:1:1130636001:1.female: Some folks came back walking, others lying down, and some were just flat-out never seen again.

say:2:1130636002:1.text: That's just the norm in this line of work.
say:2:1130636002:1.source_cn: 干我们这行，这种事见多了。
say:2:1130636002:1.male: That's just the norm in this line of work.
say:2:1130636002:1.female: That's just the norm in this line of work.

say:3:1130636003:1.text: When I was just an apprentice, I sold seven coffins in my first week. In the second week, I sold eleven, three of which were made of walnut wood.
say:3:1130636003:1.source_cn: 我刚当学徒的时候，第一个星期卖出去七口棺材。第二个星期...
say:3:1130636003:1.male: When I was just an apprentice, I sold seven coffins in my first week. In the second week, I sold eleven, three of which were made of walnut wood.
say:3:1130636003:1.female: When I was just an apprentice, I sold seven coffins in my first week. In the second week, I sold eleven, three of which were made of walnut wood.

say:4:1130636004:1.text: I stopped counting not too long after that.
say:4:1130636004:1.source_cn: 第二个月起，我不再计数了。
say:4:1130636004:1.male: I stopped counting not too long after that.
say:4:1130636004:1.female: I stopped counting not too long after that.
